Q1View buttons

Studio puts its buttons under the Purpose. Report, Interactions, a paper Section's Work and the SPACE page put them above it, so they jump when you switch sections.

Where do the view buttons sit on every page?

Why A: It is the Studio layout you chose; the Purpose reads first.

Q2Paper pages

A paper Board, a version and a Section are 1240 pixels wide and start at the left edge; every other page is 832. Their title adds a verb: "Work · do".

Do paper pages keep their own width and verb?

Why A: The page no longer shifts when you go from a paper to a Block.

Q3Labeling pages

A labeling Job or Task page is drawn by its own code (labeling_focus.py): no left rail, 8 to 18 sections on the right, no buttons. The labeling session owns it.

Should labeling Job and Task pages move onto the shared page?

Why A: Same rails everywhere; preview A is a mock made from the real page.

Q4Small fixes

Three fixes I would make myself, listed so you can stop them.

1  the line under the title stays on every section ("3 topics", "2 Jobs")
2  b35's delivery previews get their page's right rail (today: none)
3  an old link without layout=focus is sent on to the focus page
May I make these three fixes?

Why A: Each removes one difference, and none changes what a page shows.
